title: The Shepherds and the Angels
reflectionQuestion: What do you think the shepherds felt when the whole dark sky suddenly filled with singing angels?
kidSafetyNotes: 'Good news of great joy.' The shepherds' side of the Nativity (pairs with 1829 Bethlehem). Angels are awe-not-terror ('Do not be afraid'). One image: the dark hillside suddenly filling with a sky full of singing angels. FRESH voice VOICE_LILY_WOLFF (1st use in kid lane).

scriptureKeyVerse.text: For there is born to you today, in David’s city, a Savior, who is Christ the Lord.
